'''Thakaras''' was a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who served in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sometime during the Empire's [[Sith Wars/Legends|conflicts]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Thakaras sported [[Color/Legends|blue]] skin and red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] like all Chiss and held the rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] while serving under the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Hurdenn]]. Thakaras made the mistake of correcting Hurdenn's poorly designed battle strategy and, although Thakaras's suggestion saved the offensive, an angry Hurdenn accused the Chiss&mdash;who as an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] was considered second-class in the Empire&mdash;of insubordination and demoted the officer.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thakaras was mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', a [[2012]] reference guide.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
